title: Siege of Alexandria (1801)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Alexandria (1801)", at revision 1371106346, opens: "The siege of Alexandria was fought during the French Revolutionary Wars between French and British forces. It was the last action of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria (1798–1801). The French had occupied Alexandria, a major fortified harbour city on the Nile Delta in northern Egypt, since 2 July 1798, and the garrison there surrendered on 2 September 1801." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3485805, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1801 siege during the French Campaign in Egypt and Syria". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
